title: Raudonė Castle
geometryBasis: Use the named survey outline for the three ranges and round towers, the local site-height record for the great tower, and the two exact Qualla exteriors for roof colors, floor divisions, window types and decorative banding.
sectionBasis: The taller red-brick circular tower on the south wing rises above the open courtyard and red tile wings. Smaller crenellated turrets project from the outside walls. The courtyard elevation is divided by rectangular pale-framed windows and a low projecting entrance bay.
limitations: Minor roof slopes, decorative brick divisions and elevations beyond the two source views are reconstructed at the fidelity appropriate for Earth view.
The model covers the castle proper. The separate granary, mill and estate park are outside its footprint.
